title: Roadmap to Freedom: Theme 1, Session 1- Would You Kill for a Just Cause?
description:
Roadmap to Freedom is an inspirational weekly educational series on  freedom, liberty and history. 

Subscribe to our channel to never miss an episode: https://www.youtube.com/@LibertarianParty

Roadmap to Freedom is a contributed series from former member of the EC of the California Libertarian Party, as well as its former head of Media and Communications, Leon Weinstein.  Leon hails from St. Petersburg, Russia, the same city as Ayn Rand. His grandmother studied with Rand at university, and it was through Rand's writings that Leon became interested in capitalism, free markets, and the philosophy of individualism.

He is an accomplished entrepreneur, playwright, and author. Currently, Leon manages an artist representation company involved in art publishing, wholesale, and distribution of fine art. He also hosts radio and internet programs, continuing his mission to prevent socialism from taking hold in the United States.
